name: Arun Das
biography: A veteran engineering executive responsible for strategy, output and commercial performance across Helix's propulsion business.
personality: Measured, technically literate and intolerant of avoidable operational risk.
visualDescription: Late-50s man with close-cropped silver hair, formal graphite Helix executive jacket with a narrow bronze collar line.

image.promptDescription: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a veteran Helix engineering executive in a graphite and bronze corporate office.

name: Talia Chen
biography: Talia built her career in specialist metals sourcing before moving into Helix propulsion procurement, where she now controls supplier qualification for materials that can stop drive assembly if supply fails.
personality: Calm, concise and commercially pragmatic; values reliable suppliers over flashy promises.
visualDescription: Woman in her early 40s, neat dark hair, practical graphite corporate jacket with a bronze Helix badge.

image.promptDescription: Head-and-shoulders portrait of Talia Chen in a high-end orbital procurement office with freight traffic outside, graphite and bronze Helix styling.

name: Marcus Vale
biography: Marcus moved from propulsion-line engineering into plant leadership and now owns day-to-day delivery performance at Solace Driveworks.
personality: Direct, production-focused and protective of engineering quality gates.
visualDescription: Middle-aged man in practical dark Helix operations clothing with bronze plant-authority markings.

image.promptDescription: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a propulsion factory operations director in a vast graphite-and-bronze manufacturing control room.

name: Dr Imani Okoro
biography: A systems biologist directing Verdant Horizon's closed-habitat nutrition and biological resilience programmes.
personality: Curious, methodical and strongly oriented toward practical colony survival rather than prestige research.
visualDescription: Woman in her late 40s with short natural hair, clean white Verdant research jacket with dark green detailing.

image.promptDescription: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a habitat bioscience director in a bright growth laboratory, white and botanical-green Verdant styling.

name: Lena Ortiz
biography: Lena coordinates external sourcing of unusual biological feedstocks and nutrient precursors needed by Verdant's habitat research programmes.
personality: Friendly but exacting about provenance, contamination controls and delivery conditions.
visualDescription: Latina woman in her late 30s wearing a white and dark-green Verdant procurement jacket in a clean bioscience logistics office.

image.promptDescription: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a biotech procurement lead in a clean bioscience logistics office, white and botanical green styling.
